nodes.name: sync_oauth.rs
nodes.summary: Debug-only `/agent/test/sync/oauth/*` endpoints exercising Linear's OAuth authorization-code + PKCE flow and connection-token refresh against a self-hosted mock token endpoint, plus token inspection/seeding helpers.

nodes.name: stop_mock_server_inner
nodes.summary: Stop and drop any prior live mock server. Idempotent.

nodes.name: test_oauth_mock_server_start
nodes.summary: Bring up a fresh mock server bound to an ephemeral loopback port. Idempotent: any prior server is torn down first.  Returns { url } — the absolute URL the e2e scenario should pass to oauth/set-token-endpoint.

nodes.name: test_oauth_mock_server_stop
nodes.summary: Tear down the live mock server, if any. Idempotent.

nodes.name: test_oauth_mock_server_status
nodes.summary: Snapshot of the live mock server: bound url + how many POST /oauth/token requests have hit it. Lets scenarios assert the production code actually called through to the mock (and didn't short-circuit on a cached token).

nodes.name: mock_token_handler
nodes.summary: Implements `mock_token_handler(State(state))` in sync_oauth.rs.

nodes.name: test_oauth_set_token_endpoint
nodes.summary: Install (or clear) the Linear /oauth/token URL override. Backed by oauth::linear::set_test_token_endpoint. Used by every OAuth scenario to redirect the production code at the in-process mock.

nodes.name: test_oauth_set_client_id
nodes.summary: Install (or clear) the test override for the Linear OAuth client id. Backed by oauth::linear::set_test_client_id. Required so the ensure-fresh-token and start paths can run without depending on ORGII_LINEAR_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID being set at build time on dev / CI machines.

nodes.name: test_oauth_start
nodes.summary: Drive the shared commands_sync::start_oauth_flow_inner code path with skip_browser=true so the e2e harness exercises the same descriptor + PENDING_FLOWS registration logic the production connection OAuth start command runs. The only short-circuit is the...

nodes.name: test_oauth_simulate_callback
nodes.summary: Simulate the browser's redirect to http://127.0.0.1:{port}/callback?code=…&state=… without binding a real port.  Returns { ok: true } when the exchange succeeded and the token landed in the store. Returns an error string containing "state_mismatch" when the caller-supplied state...

nodes.name: test_oauth_cancel
nodes.summary: Cancel the pending flow for (connection_id, adapter_id) and drop it from the registry.

nodes.name: test_oauth_ensure_fresh_token
nodes.summary: Force a refresh through oauth::ensure_fresh_connection_token. Returns { ok: true, refreshed: true } if the call succeeded, or { ok: false, error } if it failed. The bearer is **never** echoed back — the scenario asserts refresh side effects via oauth/token instead.

nodes.name: simulate_connection_redirect_callback
nodes.summary: Implements `simulate_connection_redirect_callback(connection_id, adapter_id, code, state)` in sync_oauth.rs.

nodes.name: test_oauth_token
nodes.summary: Non-secret projection of the stored ConnectionTokenRecord for connection_id. NEVER returns the access token or refresh token plaintext — scenarios assert presence + expiry + source, never the bearer bytes themselves.

nodes.name: test_oauth_seed_token
nodes.summary: Pre-stash a typed ConnectionTokenRecord for connection_id. Used by the refresh scenarios to seed an expired bearer + refresh token before driving the worker.

nodes.name: test_oauth_clear_token
nodes.summary: Forget the stored token for connection_id. Idempotent. Wraps connection_token_store::clear; called by every OAuth scenario in the cleanup tail.
